invariants.rationale: instantTime is likely required to be non-null to uniquely identify the commit.
partitionPath is likely required to be non-null to specify the partition being committed.
records is required in the bulk commit process to contain data to be written, so should not be null.
indexParser is provided as a method parameter, and it is likely that it should not be null to correctly interpret file group indices.
instantTime should not be the empty string, as it probably represents a meaningful timestamp or ID.
